Lines.zh: 你们已经彻底激怒我了！我将率领我的精英部队打败你们！
Lines.en: You have thoroughly exasperated me! I will lead my elite forces to defeat you!
Can it help me find the burritos?

Lines.zh: 数据显示，僵尸博士口中的“精英部队”找到玉米卷的概率为0.007891%。
Lines.en: The data showed that the probability of Zomboss's "elite forces" finding a burrito is 0.007891%.

Lines.zh: 蠢货！我的精英部队可不是帮你们找玉米卷的！
Lines.en: Stop messing around! My elite forces isn't here to help you find burritos!

Lines.zh: 你们马上就会见识到的。
